# VIX General Services

## Core Services & Canonical URLs

### 1. Outdoor & Landscape Lighting
- **URL**: https://www.vixgeneralservices.com/services/outdoor-lighting
- **Summary**: Architectural and landscape low-voltage (12V) LED lighting systems. Solid cast-brass IP65 fixtures (6W 3000K warm white), double-head pole lights with dusk-to-dawn sensors, 6-zone layout distribution, 100W–300W weatherproof transformers, Schedule 40 PVC conduit underground trenching, and annual maintenance plans ($780/year).
- **Slogan**: "Lighting that enhances your lifestyle"

### 2. Security Camera & Surveillance Systems
- **URL**: https://www.vixgeneralservices.com/services/security-cameras
- **Summary**: Professional wired Power over Ethernet (PoE) security systems. Motorized 360° pan-tilt-zoom (PTZ) 4MP/4K IP66 outdoor cameras, 4K network video recorders (NVR) with 2TB+ local storage, zero monthly cloud subscription fees, infrared night vision, direct-burial Cat6 cabling, and 24/7 remote viewing via iOS and Android apps.

### 3. Smart Control Hub & Automation Systems
- **URL**: https://www.vixgeneralservices.com/services/smart-automation
- **Summary**: Centralized smart automation for outdoor lighting, pool systems, and electrical circuits. AquaLink RS and smart Wi-Fi gateways, NEMA 3R commercial-grade outdoor distribution panels, Eaton Type 2 surge protective devices (SPD), astronomical sunset/sunrise clock scheduling, and multi-zone smartphone control.

### 4. HVAC & Air Conditioning Services
- **URL**: https://www.vixgeneralservices.com/services/hvac
- **Summary**: Full-spectrum residential and commercial cooling and heating. Rapid emergency diagnostics, high-efficiency SEER2 heat pump and central AC installations, ductwork repair, indoor air quality filtration, UV germicidal lamps, and seasonal preventative maintenance.

### 5. Licensed Electrical Services
- **URL**: https://www.vixgeneralservices.com/services/electrical
- **Summary**: Comprehensive electrical contracting to strict NEC and Florida Building Code standards. 200A and 400A breaker panel upgrades, aluminum wire mitigation, whole-home surge protection, recessed canless LED lighting, subpanels, and insurance 4-Point inspection code corrections.

### 6. Custom Solar Energy Systems
- **URL**: https://www.vixgeneralservices.com/services/solar
- **Summary**: Turnkey residential and commercial rooftop solar panel systems. High-output Tier-1 monocrystalline panels with 25-year warranties, Tesla Powerwall and Enphase battery storage, FPL bi-directional net metering approvals, and Category 5 hurricane-rated structural racking.

### 7. EV Charging Station Installation
- **URL**: https://www.vixgeneralservices.com/services/ev-charging
- **Summary**: Certified Level 2 (240V) electric vehicle charger installations. Tesla Universal Wall Connector, ChargePoint, JuiceBox, dedicated 50A/60A circuits, industrial NEMA 14-50 receptacles, load calculation audits, and utility rebate assistance.
